content.title: Event Poster Activation | Layer Release, Reading Order and Full Flyer Return
content.summary: A night-market poster becomes a short announcement and returns complete. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One fixed four-color system persists. + A single accent dot initiates the sequence. + Every cell transformation follows the same directional beat. + Letter assembly remains legible before collapse. + The final lockup contains only original copy and preserves the earlier geometry.
quick_start.recommended_input: Present one complete original night-market flyer with a cobalt title, coral jacket, tea cup and tram icon. Release the jacket, cup and tram in that order, each completing one short bounded motion. Reassemble every layer into the opening flyer and hold the complete announcement for two beats.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先保留完整海报作为信息基线，再让标题字、人物服装、饮品和交通图形按阅读顺序拆层运动；色彩与版式始终同源，最终回到完整告知稿。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: The complete information hierarchy is shown before animation.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "The complete information hierarchy is shown before animation."

invariants.rule: One registered grid and palette persist.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "One registered grid and palette persist."

invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Objects animate in reading order."

invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Motion never hides required copy."

invariants.rule: The final frame restores a fully readable original flyer.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final frame restores a fully readable original flyer."
